channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Trump says Iran war will be over "when we want to end it"
item.description: President Trump spoke about the Iran war during a Veterans Day address at Arlington National Cemetery.

item.title: With Jim Jordan as leader, House GOP signals it's ready to fight
item.description: Republicans described the incoming minority leader as a "fighter" who can go head to head with Hakeem Jeffries.

item.title: ICE deportations and arrests hit record high
item.description: New Department of Homeland Security figures show more than 483,000 deportations and 491,000 immigration arrests in fiscal year 2026.

item.title: At least 5 killed, 19 hurt in Brooklyn building collapse
item.description: A major technical rescue operation was ongoing, involving hundreds of firefighters.
